title: PRODUCER FX you can hear and see: bolder effects, on-screen feedback, FX RACK, master limiter
subject: README: PRODUCER FX visuals, FX RACK, master limiter, fx-audit script

mappings.label: INSTRUMENTS
mappings.description: Each move plays a part: block = 808, slash = lead (your synth patch), stab = hats/perc, flourish = vocal chops. A miss mutes or glitches that part.

mappings.label: SWORD SFX
mappings.description: Moves make sword sounds; the song plays as written.

mappings.label: B · PRODUCER FX
mappings.description: Each move is a mix-wide effect: BLOCK pumps, SLASH sweeps a filter, STAB stutters, FLOURISH lifts into the next bar. Misses fumble the effect.

mappings.label: C · HYBRID
mappings.description: Moves play instruments (808, lead, hats, vocal chops); a clean combo measure fires a production flourish at the bar line.

experiments.label: BASELINE · 4 LANES
experiments.description: The current game: four lanes on the floor, cues scroll to a hit line.
